d: Enjoy all goals and match highlights from Morocco vs Spain in Group H of the FIFA U-17 World Cup Qatar 2026. Spain secured a 2-0 group stage win at Aspire Zone in Doha as Ebrima Tunkara struck in the first half and Guillermo Trujillano doubled the lead after the break. Spain top Group H with a perfect nine points, while Morocco still finish second on goal difference to reach the Round of 32.
